class.name: UltralightTask
class.brief_description: Single-completion asynchronous operation with a retained result.
class.description: Check is_completed before awaiting completed because an operation may finish synchronously. Read get_result afterwards; the result remains available. Only the first terminal operation takes effect. Cancel stops this observation or delivery without undoing business side effects or forcibly terminating a JavaScript Promise. Public resolve/reject are used by register_async handlers.

method.name: is_completed
method.description: Return whether a terminal result is retained.

method.name: get_result
method.description: Return the retained result, or null before completion.

method.name: resolve
method.description: Complete a host async request successfully. Repeated completion is ignored. Main thread only.

method.name: reject
method.description: Complete a host async request with the provided error code and message. Main thread only.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Complete with Cancelled if still pending. Does not undo already executed operations. Main thread only.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once when the task reaches its terminal state. Check is_completed before awaiting, then call get_result.
